title: 第364章 活着比什么都重要第363章 他死了
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
;;
樱落摆出一副傲娇的样子，语气酸溜溜的。
“你刚才整我的时候不是厉害的很吗？都什么时候了，你还有心情和我开玩笑，真是气死我了！”
齐煜讪讪一笑，“刚才我不过就是想调节一下气氛而已嘛！不过你也知道，我的身体状况，这次好不容易捡回来的半条命，大夫都说了需要静养，要是再被你这么折腾着，我这剩下的半条命也没了。”
“你说什么呢你？别瞎说。”
樱落下意识的白了他一眼。
随后也是听进去了他说的话，手上戳他的动作也没再进行，反而还帮他盖好了毯子。
“我可是一点儿都没发现，你觉得你错了！不过，只要你平安无事，我便什么气都消了。”
其实樱落也没想着怎么欺负他，就是心里气愤想发泄出来。连手上挠他和戳他的力度都是经过再三斟酌之后的。
“五殿下，你伤怎么样了？大夫到底是怎么说的？会有什么后遗症吗？”樱落着急的问道。
自从自己醒来之后，就一心想着来见他。
见了他之后，一直没有机会问他的伤势，眼下得空了，这才开口问道。
“本王的伤嘛……自然是……”
看着樱落一副焦急担心的样子，齐煜下意识就要脱口而出的话，瞬间戛然而止了。
于是，他转了话头，做出了一副委屈至极又可怜兮兮的模样。
“自然是十分的不好，伤口很疼的……”
“我知道，你受了这么严重的伤，怎么可能会不疼呢？大夫到底是怎么说的？”
“大夫说本王需要日日保持好心情，千万不能生气，要事事顺心，这样伤势才会好的快一些！”
其实齐煜想说的是，樱落千万不要惹他生气。
天天让他能够看到她，事事顺遂他的心意，便好得快许多。

齐煜想得很美好，如此美妙的想法让他整个人都喜不自胜了起来。
只是，樱落一听他说的这些话，瞬间蹙了蹙眉头。
哈？
日日保持好心情？千万不能生气？事事顺心？
这不是郁结在心的方子吗？
他这是箭伤好吗？
哪有开这种方子的啊？
这是什么大夫？到底还会不会看病了？
樱落有些无语，“你确定这是大夫给你开的方子？”
齐煜点了点头，语气无比肯定。
“你要是不信本王，你可以去问问大夫啊！”
樱落撅了噘嘴，无情吐槽道：
“要不我们换个大夫看吧？我总觉得这个大夫没什么本事，看不好你的伤。”
确实是没本事。
要是有本事了，也不至于说出这样一番驴唇不对马嘴的话。
“啊？什么没本事了？”齐煜不解。
他怎么就看不出来，给自己瞧病的这个大夫没本事了？！
人家明明是临城里，有名的大夫好吗？
怎么到樱落的嘴里，就成了没本事的人了？
“他要是有本事，就不会给你开这样的方子了！五殿下，你别拿自己的伤不当一回事，我明明在城墙上看着……看着那支箭几乎贯穿了你的后背，血流不止。你本就身体不好，这次又受了这么重的伤，我真的好怕，你会挺不过去。”

齐煜一时间愣住了，竟无言以对。

Yingluo put on a arrogant look and spoke in a sour tone.
"Weren't you very powerful when you punished me just now? It's been so long, and you're still in the mood to joke with me. I'm really pissed off!"
Qi Yu smiled coquettishly, "I just wanted to adjust the atmosphere! But you also know that my physical condition, the half life I finally recovered this time, the doctor said I need to rest. If I continue to be tortured like this by you, my remaining half life will be gone."
"What did you say? Don't talk nonsense."
Yingluo rolled her eyes at him subconsciously.
Then she listened to what he said and stopped poking him. Instead, she covered him with a blanket.
"I didn't notice it at all. You think you are wrong! However, as long as you are safe, I will be relieved of all my anger."
In fact, Yingluo didn't even think about how to bully him, she just wanted to vent her anger. Even the intensity of tickling and poking him was carefully considered.
"Your Highness, how is your injury? What did the doctor say? Are there any sequelae?" Ying Luo asked anxiously.
Ever since I woke up, all I wanted to do was come see him.
After meeting him, I never had the chance to ask him about his injuries. Now that I was free, I asked.
"My king's injury...is naturally..."
Seeing Ying Luo's anxious and worried look, Qi Yu's subconscious words suddenly stopped.
So, he changed his subject and looked extremely aggrieved and pitiful.
"Of course it's very bad, the wound is very painful..."
"I know, you were so seriously injured, how could it not hurt? What did the doctor say?"
"The doctor said that I need to stay in a good mood every day, never get angry, and do everything as I wish, so that the injury will heal faster!"
In fact, what Qi Yu wanted to say was that Ying Luo must not make him angry.
Let him see her every day, and everything will go according to his wishes, and it will be much better.
Qi Yu had a wonderful thought, and such a wonderful thought made him overjoyed.
However, when Yingluo heard what he said, she frowned instantly.
ha?
Stay in a good mood every day? Don't be angry? Everything goes well?
Isn’t this a recipe that’s stuck in my heart?
Is he injured by an arrow?
How can anyone prescribe such a prescription?
What kind of doctor is this? Will he still see a doctor?
Yingluo was speechless, "Are you sure this is the prescription the doctor prescribed for you?"
Qi Yu nodded, his tone extremely sure.
"If you don't believe me, you can ask the doctor!"
Yingluo pouted and complained ruthlessly:
"How about we look at another doctor? I always feel that this doctor is incompetent and can't see your injuries well."
He really has no ability.
If you had the ability, you wouldn't say such nonsense.
"Ah? What's wrong with you?" Qi Yu was puzzled.
Why couldn't he see that the doctor who treated him was incompetent? !
He is obviously from Lincheng, how about a famous doctor?
How come Ying Luo has turned into a person without any ability?
"If he had the ability, he wouldn't give you such a prescription! Your Highness, please don't take your injuries seriously. I was clearly watching from the city wall... I saw the arrow almost penetrated your back and the blood was flowing. You are already in poor health, and you have been so seriously injured this time. I am really afraid that you will not be able to survive."
Qi Yu was stunned for a moment and was speechless.
